title: This Device Uses A.I. and Lasers to Kill Mosquitoes
description: A Chinese start-up has developed a device that uses artificial intelligence and lasers to kill mosquitoes. But there are safety concerns for people and other creatures nearby when the device is in action.
author: Keith Bradsher, Nailah Morgan, Qilai Shen and Siyi Zhao

title: Binance Grapples With ‘Security Incident’ That May Cause $6.3 Billion in Losses
description: The world’s largest crypto exchange suspended deposits and withdrawals after an apparent hack.
author: David Yaffe-Bellany

title: Big Tech’s Data Center Blitz Is Burning Through Cash and Scaring Wall St.
description: Amazon on Thursday became the latest tech company to announce swelling investments in A.I. amid stumbling share prices.
author: Karen Weise

title: Intel’s Shares Plunge 20% as A.I. Hinders Some Parts of Its Business
description: The chipmaker, whose largest investor is the U.S. government, reported that the A.I. boom’s domino effect had hurt sales to personal computer makers.
author: Don Clark

title: Polymarket and Kalshi Turn Midterm Elections Into a Multimillion Dollar Market
description: Betting markets like Polymarket and Kalshi have transformed America’s democracy into a new kind of casino.
author: Stuart A. Thompson and Lauren McCarthy

title: DoorDash to Buy Instacart for $17 Billion, Uniting 2 Delivery Giants
description: The deal combines the country’s largest restaurant delivery service with its biggest online grocery platform.
author: Emmy Martin and Lauren McCarthy

title: Microsoft’s Profit Jumps 32% Despite Big Increase in Spending
description: The company’s free cash flow stayed positive in the last quarter even as it spent $45.2 billion on capital expenses like data centers and offered to pay workers to leave.
author: Emmy Martin

title: Bodacious A.I. Bots Are Stealing Jokes From Young Female Comedians
description: Swiping jokes word for word, these bodacious bots mainly lift from young female comedians. What’s so insidious is how they’re subtly changing us, the audience.
author: Jason Zinoman

title: Hit the Road This Season With These Useful New Map Features
description: The recent updates to Google Maps and Apple’s Maps use artificial (and human) intelligence for better navigation, planning and travel guides.
author: J. D. Biersdorfer

title: Alphabet’s Revenue Rises 25% as Profit Falls
description: The company has been spending relentlessly to build A.I. and said it would increase those investments next year. Profit dropped because of changes to the value of its investments.
author: Kate Conger

title: AI Is Finding a Flood of Bugs, and Silicon Valley Is Rushing to Fix Them
description: A.I. has uncovered a horde of software flaws, which engineers are racing to fix before they can be exploited and abused by hackers.
author: Kate Conger

title: Apple Unveils Its First Touch-Screen MacBook Pro
description: Steve Jobs and Tim Cook both dismissed the idea, but Apple’s new chief executive is reimagining some of the company’s most important products.
author: Kalley Huang and Brian X. Chen

title: Wanted: Robot-Dog Walkers. $20/Hour.
description: No pooper scooper required.
author: Kashmir Hill

title: GM Is Leaving NYSE for the Nasdaq After More Than 100 Years
description: After more than 100 years on the New York Stock Exchange, the automaker is shifting its listing to the Nasdaq, which is home to many technology companies.
author: Aruni Soni

title: How Billionaires Are Fighting the Prop 40 California Wealth Tax
description: The latest Silicon Valley billionaire club is a $333 million political ad machine that is heavily engaged in next week’s elections.
author: Theodore Schleifer and Erin Griffith

title: In the A.I. ‘Robogym,’ Machines Train to Be More Like Humans
description: Germany’s Neura is one of the companies at the forefront of efforts to use artificial intelligence in robotics, and crucial to whether Europe can close the gap with China.
author: James Paton

title: The Key Numbers From Anthropic’s IPO Filing
description: We broke down the A.I. company’s key figures, which give insight into the health of its business, its future plans and who’s in charge.
author: Sri Muppidi and Lauren Hirsch

title: Microsoft Offers Buyouts to 60,000 Employees as It Spends on A.I.
description: About a quarter of the tech giant’s employees were eligible for the packages, although the company cautioned it did not expect many employees to sign on.
author: Karen Weise

title: Anthropic’s IPO S-1 Spells Out a Future of Promise and Peril
description: The A.I. company took great pains to describe the many benefits that can come from using its Claude chatbot and technology, but also offered up a heavy dose of gloom.
author: Mike Isaac

title: What’s Riding on Anthropic Going Public? Nearly Everything.
description: Anthropic sits atop a pyramid of business partners and suppliers, making it a barometer of the broader economy. Its initial public offering will have widespread implications.
author: Erin Griffith and Lauren Hirsch
